name: HFb
label: C (given the model choices) unless a field says E
note: ACT-centred n_s; spectator mass from the curvature coupling, m_s^2 = 9 H_i^2 + xi_s R, xi_s = -3/4
slice: a = 1, H = H_i at sigma = sigma_c (end of slow roll; eps_H ~ 1e-7; R = 12 H_i^2), M1r static-slice analogue

reheating.label: E: non-perturbative axial rates from the [C] half-period table, no back-reaction on the modes

history_columns.t: cosmic time in H_i^-1 from the slice
history_columns.R: Ricci scalar / H_i^2 (exact in the homogeneous part; cycle mean in the fluid part)
history_columns.R_osc_sig: amplitude of the 2 m_sig oscillation of R (fluid part)
history_columns.s_over_sstar: holder spectator s/s_* (exact to t ~ 60, then its WKB envelope; see s_is_envelope)
history_columns.f_sig: energy fraction in the sigma condensate
history_columns.K_running: a^2 H / H_i (converges to K in radiation)

extra_params.higgs: no tree-level portal of the Higgs to sigma, chi or s (lam_chiH = lam_sigmaH = lam_sH = 0, model choice); xi_H = 0.1 (M1r)
extra_params.N_singlets: four Majorana singlets, -(M_j/2) Nbar_j exp(i gamma5 phi/f_j) N_j with phi = sigma (j=1) or chi (j=2,3,4); seesaw y_nu^2 = m_nu M/v_EW^2 with m_nu = 0.05 eV, v_EW = 174.1 GeV; N -> L H
extra_params.s_decay: y_s s Nbar_s N_s with y_s = 4.6e-3 (light N_s, N_s -> i gamma5 N_s keeps s -> -s), Gamma_s = 1.26e-6 H_i after unblocking at a ~ 31 [E]
extra_params.hidden_sector: M1r at lambda_Y = lambda_Sigma = 0.5 (BRIEF_DECISIVE), holder on s instead of the inflaton; no sigma/chi-hidden portals (sequestered by choice)
extra_params.slice_note: t = 0, N = 0 at sigma = sigma_c; eps_H = 1 at t = 0.1925 with H/H_i = 0.9966

status: final for the stated model choices (homogeneous + fluid; the reheating rates are [E]); see STATUS.md
